decks.summary: PlayingBoardGames' tank Hank who takes damage and horror for the team with Cherished Keepsake, Hunting Jacket, Jessica Hyde and Peter Sylvestre, fighting with Baseball Bats, Hatchets and Pitchforks.
Ascetic Hank built around Gift of Nodens, recycling skills and Improvised Weapons from his discard pile with Profane Idol and Short Supply, and fighting with Meat Cleavers.
Tank Hank who cancels damage and horror with Improvised Shield and Idol of Xanatos and replays Hatchets and Fire Extinguishers with Pushed to the Limit and Salvage; no clues.
Two-box Hemlock Vale Hank who survives his Resolute side with Cunning Distraction, Elaborate Distraction and Stall for Time, fighting with Baseball Bats and Pitchforks.
Level 0 Hank with four two-handed weapons, Cherished Keepsake, Leather Coat and Peter Sylvestre to soak, and Wrong Place, Right Time to shift damage and draw.
Spanish-podcast Dark Horse Hank with Fire Axe and Madame Labranche, Hatchets and Pitchforks replayed through Pushed to the Limit, and Idol of Xanatos for protection.
Main-fighter Hank who soaks the team's damage and heals it off with Second Wind and Jessica Hyde, fighting with Pitchforks and Sledgehammers kept on a Tool Belt.
Assistant-side Hank built for his Resolute stats: Dark Horse, Granny Orne and Pocket Multi Tool push him toward 7 in everything, with Fire Axe and Dig Deep to spend down his money.
Soak-and-heal Hank with Cherished Keepsakes, Leather Coats and Talisman of Protection, Pitchforks to fight, and Bandages and Second Wind to recover.
Hellboy-themed Hank with Timeworn Brand and the Hyperphysical Shotcaster at 8 or 9 fight, Meat Cleavers and One-Two Punch, and Peter Sylvestre and Jessica Hyde to soak.
